title: FYLO namespace lease record (DRAFT, ADR 0033 section 4; written by the root lease since L1-3)
description: Describes <drive>/<app>/.<namespace>.fylo-root-owner.lock.json. Written by temporary file and rename. The owner owns the namespace while it holds the kernel lock on .<namespace>.fylo-root-owner.lock AND this record names its ownerId and generation.

namespace.description: The owned folder's name. Until the layout release this is the root folder's name and may not match the pattern.

ownerId.description: 128 random bits, new for every process start, as 32 lowercase hex characters.

generation.description: The fencing number. Grows by one at every claim; never goes back, also across clean stops.

heartbeat.description: Grows by one every heartbeat interval while the owner lives. A taker compares two readings taken the takeover time apart on its own clock.

state.description: released: the last owner stopped cleanly; the next owner claims at once.

host.description: Diagnostic only. Never used to decide ownership.

pid.description: The owner's process id. Used with machine and processStart only on the same machine; diagnostic everywhere else.

heartbeatMillis.description: The owner's heartbeat interval in milliseconds. Default 5000 (FYLO_LEASE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS).

takeoverMillis.description: The owner's takeover time in milliseconds. Default 20000 (FYLO_LEASE_TAKEOVER_SECONDS). Greater than heartbeatMillis. A taker waits the longer of its own takeover time and this one.

machine.description: A stable id of the owner's machine: 32 lowercase hex characters of a SHA-256 over the platform's machine id (ADR 0033 section 4, Stopping). Absent where the platform has none. Only used to decide whether the owner's pid may be checked here.

processStart.description: The owner process's start time as the platform reports it. A taker on the same machine takes over at once when pid now names no process or one with another start time.
